description.value: Nautical Nellies Steak & Seafood House has anchored Victoria's Inner Harbour waterfront since 1997, founded by Jeff and Betty Furneaux from Newfoundland with a focus on warm hospitality and premium ingredients. The restaurant is known for Ocean Wise-certified Pacific seafood, prime-aged steaks including a signature tomahawk, hand-rolled sushi, and daily brunch, served from a heated harbour-view patio or a cozy interior with original artwork by co-owner Jeff Furneaux. A live lobster and crab tank, an oyster bar with fresh shucking, and a Wine Spectator award-winning list of 165+ wines round out an experience that places it firmly among Victoria's most celebrated dining destinations.
